2609.27749.title: Evaluation of pre-trained models for pedagogical assessment of novel AI-assisted educational questions
2609.27749.paper_summary: The surge in AI-assisted generation of educational materials has outpaced our capacity to validate their pedagogical quality. Automated evaluation using Bloom Classifier models is a promising approach to assess educational materials at scale. These models show high accuracy within-distribution dataset (IID Dataset). However, applying the same models to new out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets such as AI-assisted generated questions could show performance degradation. To identify robust classifiers under dataset shift, we evaluated traditional Machine Learning (ML), transformer, and Large Language models on the Bloom level classification task. We also explored feature-engineering strategies incorporating NLP metrics, appending the learning objectives as part of the input, and text splicing to stabilize OOD performance. Our baseline tests show that TFPOS-IDF ML models perform poorly on OOD (Macro F1-score 0.48) compared to BERT (0.55) and LLMs (0.79). Text splicing improved macro F1-score performance of ML and BERT models (0.59 and 0.62, respectively). Appending the learning objectives with the input increased model performance on specific dataset. Model retraining provided the largest improvement across models and datasets. Overall, these findings highlight the trade-off on the use of pre-trained models with novel AI-assisted educational questions and how strategic feature enhancements help address loss in performance.
2609.27749.paper_summary_zh: 教育材料的 AI 輔助生成激增，超出了我們驗證其教學質量的能力。使用 Bloom 分類器模型的自動評估是一種有前景的方法，可以大規模評估教育材料。這些模型在內部分佈數據集（IID 數據集）中顯示出高準確性。然而，將相同的模型應用於新的分佈外（OOD）數據集，例如 AI 輔助生成的問題，可能會顯示出性能下降。為了識別在數據集轉移下的穩健分類器，我們對傳統機器學習（ML）、Transformer和大型語言模型在 Bloom 級別分類任務上進行了評估。我們還探索了結合 NLP 指標的特徵工程策略，將學習目標作為輸入的一部分，並進行文本拼接以穩定 OOD 性能。我們的基準測試顯示，TFPOS-IDF ML 模型在 OOD 上表現不佳（宏 F1 分數 0.48），相比之下 BERT 為 0.55，LLMs 為 0.79。文本拼接改善了 ML 和 BERT 模型的宏 F1 分數表現（分別為 0.59 和 0.62）。將學習目標附加到輸入中提高了模型在特定數據集上的性能。模型重新訓練在各模型和數據集之間提供了最大的改進。總體而言，這些發現突顯了使用預訓練模型與新型 AI 輔助教育問題之間的權衡，以及如何通過戰略性特徵增強來幫助解決性能下降的問題。
